prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all specific change types (sign_in reorder, home redesign, finish layout, choose_path copy) as each has only been tested once.
Predictions were consistently too optimistic across all tests compared to measured outcomes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, copy: +1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -0.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Card Stage Redesign: Redesign the initial story screen into a stage layout featuring companion animations and vibrant intro cards. This gives immediate visual feedback about what the desktop pet app offers before path selection. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean duration of 514s and drop-off to 76.2%. Setting clear visual expectations early engages users right away.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation Progress & Estimate: Display explicit status progress indicators and remaining time estimates on the waiting screen while the desktop pet environment initializes. (why: The home/waiting step has a very high median (201s) and mean time (2336s), leading to user drop-off (81.3% conversion) and support reports of pets failing to open.)
2: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification Switch: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen to inform users when pet initialization completes. (why: Median wait time is 201s and mean is 2336s; users tab away during waiting and forget to return to the app.)

scores.note: Redesigns have shown poor historical lift (-2.5% to 0.0%) and require new screens.
Both funnel wait times and support emails confirm user confusion during initialization.
Low-cost notification toggle directly addresses tab-away drop-off during long wait times.
